args.title: The Unfinished Narrative
args.subtitle: Acne Studios Seongsu: A temporal suspension of industrial progress.
args.line: A raw, unfinished concrete skeleton reclaimed by the delicate precision of Scandinavian design.
args.synopsis: You enter a raw, exposed concrete skeleton in the heart of Seongsu. A towering structure of rusted scaffolding dominates the center, acting as a beacon of industrial progress. Around it, translucent tarp displays float like ghosts, holding the latest collections in a fragile embrace. As you navigate the path to the back-right counter, the boundaries between building site and luxury boutique dissolve.
args.quote: Fashion emerges from the chaos of construction.

why.d: The concrete path creates a tactile tension, echoing the raw street atmosphere of the neighbourhood.
The towering scaffolding commands the space, serving as an architectural skeleton for the brand.
These tarp structures soften the industrial environment, offering a surreal display for the collection.
The minimalist counter provides a grounding point, reflecting the brand's disciplined focus amidst the surrounding chaos.
